tagline: Rule-guided editorial studio: from craft rules to long-form restructuring
role: de-llm hands the model a catalogue of source-grounded craft rules mined from ~30 books on craft, storytelling and creative nonfiction (385 rules in 6 packs), lets it select only the rules that fit, anchors every proposed change to exact source text and keeps every edit pending until the author adopts it. Its long-form program diagnoses a document's architecture, imagines rival architectures, writes a Restructuring Memo the author chooses from, regenerates section by section and audits cold.
contributes: restructuring engines: deep read, card deck, architecture candidates, realization plan, section rewrite
editing engines: rules at the desk, repair, resolution, rephrase suite
quality gates: coherence audit, independent reader, drift adjudication, stance placement
narrative stance: 16 dimensions of how an argument is told
